author: copilot
subject: Fixed strict-client list output and terminal waitingOn
body: Fixed both defects. exchange_list now returns {"threads": [...]} so structuredContent is always an object, and call_tool rejects any future non-object result. Resolved threads now serialize waitingOn as null. Added regressions for object-shaped structured content and terminal waitingOn; all 22 Exchange tests and Clippy pass.
